topic.title: Git Client Add-on
topic.shortdesc: The Git Client add-on integrates a full Git client into , enabling you to commit, push, pull, branch, and resolve conflicts without leaving the editor.

body.p: The Git Client add-on contributes a built-in Git client directly in . After you install the add-on, the Git Staging view provides actions for common Git commands, such as Push, Pull, Change branch, and Commit. It also includes a built-in tool for comparing and merging changes.
